final_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
final_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods before distributing to three campus sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, with each pod containing feed handlers, analytics workloads, and execution engines. The processed data is then distributed to three campus sites, each equipped with a switch and connected via trunk links for inter-site communication.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n25) that manages inventory for various nodes across different zones, indicating a detailed asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl_new1, nl_new2, etc.) that document data flows between different nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage, such as 'Ingestion Pod', 'Market Data Pod 1', 'Market Data Pod 2', and 'Non-Production Zone'.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n11, n12) that manage data flows to and from various servers and workloads.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n13) that provides DNS services to various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n14) and a remote access control server (n27) that manage remote access to the network.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filter (n15) that provides DNS filtering services to various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a web proxy (n16) that enforces URL filtering for various nodes (e.g., n1, n2, n5).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7, z8, z9, z10, z11, z12, z13) and links that demonstrate a segmented and secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes secure network infrastructure components such as firewalls (n11, n12), DNS server (n13), and central AAA server (n17).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a central AAA server (n17) that manages authentication, authorization, and auditing for various network components.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN gateway (n26) and remote access control (n27) that ensure remote devices connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n18) that monitors network traffic for intrusions.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n11, n12) that perform traffic filtering between different network segments (e.g., z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6, z8).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes remote access control (n27) and NAC (n20) that manage access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n19) that collects network traffic flow logs from various network devices (e.g., n11, n12).

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z9) that is separate from other production zones (e.g., z1, z2, z3).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a pen testing workstation (n24) and pen testing service (n28) that perform external penetration tests on various network components.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z9 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a bastion host (n22) and links to firewalls, but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to the bastion host and firewalls.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n20) and links to firewalls, but there is no explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a remote access control system and links to the NAC and firewalls.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a pen test workstation (n24) and links to a campus site, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the pen test workstation and other relevant nodes.
